stemMarkdown: A boat whose speed in still water is 14 km/h rows 77 km downstream and returns to the starting point. If the stream flows at 6 km/h, find the total time taken (in hours). (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream: $\dfrac{77}{20} = 3.8500$ hours. Upstream: $\dfrac{77}{8} = 9.6250$ hours. Total $= 13.475$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: The return trip always takes longer than the outward one, so the round trip is never just twice the still-water time.
